description:
The list of Mobile threat Defense connectors configured by the tenant.

TIP: Lists Mobile Threat Defense (MTD) connectors. Shows which MTD partners are integrated (Microsoft Defender, Lookout, Zimperium, etc.), their state (enabled/disabled), and platform support. Each has partnerState, androidEnabled, iosEnabled, lastHeartbeatDateTime.
